import re


def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    if not text:
        return ""
    # Replace all non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens
    result = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
    # Strip any leading/trailing hyphens that were created from punctuation
    result = result.strip("-")
    return result


def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + "..."
EOF
